chat.ask: Would you like to fly in a rocket?
chat.yes: Me too! Let's go to the moon!
chat.no: That's okay! We can look at the stars from here.

text.title: A Trip to the Moon
lines: In 1969, two astronauts walked on the moon for the first time.
They flew there in a big rocket.
From the moon, they could see the Earth. It looked blue and white.
They brought some moon rocks back with them.

questions.q: How did the astronauts get to the moon?
